$comment: Hand-curated venue-name canonicalisation (AFLDB-ISSUE-093 Phase 1). Ported verbatim from the VENUE_CANONICAL constant in tools/migration/import_legacy_afl.py. Only unambiguous expansions of abbreviated source venue names; fuller canonicalisation (city, state, capacity) is a later enrichment pass and the source string is always preserved as an alias. Data only in Phase 1: the venue table itself is populated by the future fitzRoy match-results import phase, which will consume this map. Not loaded by load_reference_data.py.
